In reply to the aforesaid notice the tenant appellant had not disclosed that by a deed of assignment dated 21st June 1974 in favour of Sujoy Kumar Das Gupta sub-letting had been made. Thus this fact was not disclosed even in the reply to the notice as late as 6.6.1975.
